Ha tiknaik wan a chaan spak yuj Jehová yuj jantak heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl a milnakchamok yik tzach ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha tiknaik toxo ix yak'och opisio Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winh uninal aj Absalón. Ix jawi t'a ib'anh tiknaik yujto te milum ach anima, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia t'a winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ¿tas yuj sb'ajwajkot jun winh icha nok' chamnak tz'i' tik t'ayach? Cha in b'ati, b'at in xikel sjolom winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi': --Malaj eyalan heyik t'a jun winh tik a ex yune' ex ix Sarvia tik. Tato tzin sb'aj winh, a am Jehová tz'ak'an yal winh. Tato icha chi', malaj mach syal skachanoch waan winh, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix b'at k'elan winh t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a heb' ayoch yet' winh yajalil, ix yalan winh: --Inatax a wal winh wuninal snib'ej tzin milanchamok, okxom wal jun winh yinhtilal Benjamín tik. In sb'ajokab' winh, tekan a Jehová tz'ak'an yal winh.
Talaj ol in snakot Dios yuj in kusk'olal tik, haxo ol ajok to ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a wib'anh sk'exulok tas tz'alji tik t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix b'atxi winhaj David chi' yet' masanil heb' ajun yet'ok, hanheja' ix b'atpax winhaj Simei chi' t'a spak'ul lum witz chi', ix b'ajwajxikot winh, ix sjulankot k'een k'een winh t'a skal heb', ix slanhankot lum pokok winh t'a heb'.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj David chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi', te k'unb'inakxo heb', yuj chi' ix yik' yip heb' ta'.
Haxo winhaj Absalón yet' masanil heb' ajun pax yet'ok yet' winhaj Ahitofel, ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén.
Haxo winhaj Husai arquita yamigo winhaj David, ix elta winh scha winhaj Absalón chi', te chaanh ix awaj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Niwanokab' elk'och mamin rey, ach ik'jokab' chaanh, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Absalón chi': --¿Tom icha chi' tz'aj a naan t'a spatik winh amigo chi'? ¿Tas yuj maj ach b'at yet' winh? xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Husai chi': --Maay, manh smojok tzin b'at yet' winh. Ha mach sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, sik'b'ilpaxel yuj heb' chonhab' israel, a yet' ol in kanok.
Hanhejtona' ay mach smoj swak' serwil, ol wak' serwil winh yuninal winh wamigo chi'. Icha ix aj wak'an serwil winh a mam, icha wal chi' ol aj ach wak'anxi serwil, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winhaj Ahitofel: --¿Tas tza na' a ach tik, tas ol ko k'ulej? xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Ahitofel chi': --Ha tas tza k'ulej tiknaik to tzach way yet' heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh a mam aykan stanhwej spat, yik wach' snachajel yuj masanil heb' israel tik to tzach chakjikanel yuj winh a mam chi', haxo masanil heb' ayoch et' tik ol ach yak'och heb' yipok sk'ool, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oank'e jun mantiado heb' t'a spanhanil palacio, hata' ix way winhaj Absalón chi' yet' heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum smam chi'. T'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' chi' ix way winh yet' heb' ix.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ayik sk'anchaj razón t'a winhaj Ahitofel chi' ichato a t'a Dios wan sk'anb'an heb', yuj chi' a tas ix yal winh, ix yak'och winhaj rey David yipok sk'ool. Hanheja' icha pax chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Absalón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Ahitofel t'a winhaj Absalón chi': --Komonok syal a k'ol tzin sik'el 12 milok heb' soldado, tzin b'at t'a spatik winhaj David t'a jun ak'wal tik,
yakb'an malaj yip winh yuj k'unb'elal, ol in k'ochok. Ol in xib'tej masanil heb' ajun yet' winh, masanil heb' ol el lemnaj t'a stz'ey winh. Malaj junok mach ol in milchamok, anhej winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ol aj yoch heb' anima smasanil het'ok, yujto junnhej mach yowalil smiljichamok, haxo masanil heb' anima chi', ol och heb' t'a junk'olal het'ok, xchi winhaj Ahitofel chi'.
Ix scha sk'ol jun pensar chi' winhaj Absalón chi' yet' masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab'.
Ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' to tz'awtaj winhaj Husai arquita, yik syal winh tas sna' winh t'a yib'anh jun tik.

Haxo ix k'och winhaj Husai chi', ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' tas ix aj snaan winhaj Ahitofel chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Wach' am sko k'ulej icha syal winh tik, mato maay? ¿Tas tz'aj a naani? xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Husai chi': --Ha tas ix sna' winhaj Ahitofel t'a junel tik, manh wach'oklaj.

Ha ach tik ojtak wal to ha' winh a mam te jelan winh t'a owal yet' masanil heb' winh ajun yet' winh. Ha tiknaik te ay am kot yowal winh yet' heb' winh, icha junok nok' nun oso tz'ik'jiek' yune', icha chi' yaj heb' winh. Hanhejtona' pax winh a mam chi' te k'aynak winh yak'an owal, manhoklaj t'a skal heb' anima chi' ayek' winh t'a jun ak'wal tik.

Ha tiknaik, b'aj am sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh t'a junok nhak'een, ma t'a junokxo b'aj t'a chi'. Hanhejtona', tato t'a jun b'ab'el owal tik scham jaywanhok heb' a soldado, axom wal yel spekal chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' a soldado.

Yuj chi' wach'chom ay heb' winh max xiwtaxon icha nok' niwak choj, palta yowalil schab'axk'e sk'ol heb' winh t'a icha chi', yujto masanil heb' ketchonhab' ojtannak to te jelan winh a mam chi' t'a owal yet' heb' yet'nak winh chi'.

Ha jun tas swal t'ayach tiknaik to sb'at ko molb'ejkot masanil heb' ketisraelal yik tz'och heb' het'ok, skot t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba. Ha heb' chi' manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb' icha yarenail sti' ha' mar, a hachxo tza kuchb'ej heb' t'a owal.

Slajwi chi', tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' winh a mam yalnhej b'ajtil ayeq'ui, tzonh em t'a yib'anh winh icha yem yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh masanil anh ank'ultak. Manhxa junok heb' ayek' yet' winh chi' skani.

Wach'chom sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a junok chonhab' yalani, palta ko masanil a onh israel onh tik skik' ko lasu sko nherankot jun chonhab' chi' yet' jantak k'een k'een ayoch t'ay, skekankanb'at juynaj t'a yoltak ch'olan, manhxa junok k'een k'een skan ta', xchi winhaj Husai chi'.

Ix scha sk'ol winhaj Absalón yet' masanil heb' ichamtak winak tas ix yal winhaj Husai chi' t'a yichanh tas ix yal winhaj Ahitofel chi', wach'chom wach' ix sna' winh chi'. Ix scha sk'ol jun tik heb' yujto a Jehová ix ak'an sna heb' yik max elk'och tas ix sna winhaj Ahitofel chi'. Icha chi' ix aji yik skot t'a yib'anh winhaj Absalón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalan winhaj Husai chi' t'a winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' t'a winhaj Abiatar tas ix yal winhaj Ahitofel t'a winhaj Absalón chi' yet' t'a heb' ichamtak winak. Ix yalanpax winh tas ix aj yalani, yik b'at yal heb' yab' winhaj rey David t'a elanhchamel to max kanlaj heb' t'a lum tzinan lu'um chi' palta to tzek'kan heb' t'a junxo sk'axepal ha' Jordán yik wach' max miljicham heb'.

Haxo pax winhaj Jonatán yet' winhaj Ahimaas hato b'aj sk'eul sjaj ha' Rogel t'a stitakel chonhab', hata' ayek' heb' winh yik wach' malaj mach tz'ilan yek' heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Haxo jun ix chekab', ix b'at halan t'a heb' winh t'a elk'altak tas yaji. Ixnhej wal yab' heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Palta ay jun winh kelem unin ix ilan heb' winh, haxo winh ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Absalón chi', palta ix snael heb' winh schawanhil, yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh t'a spat jun winh kajan t'a Bahurim, t'a slak'anil chi'. Elanhchamel ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' winh t'a yol jun olan ay t'a yamaq'uil jun pat chi'.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winh aj pat chi', ix slich'b'at jun k'apak ix t'a yib'anh jun olan chi', ix sekanem ixim trigo ix t'a yib'anh yik max cheklaji.

Haxo ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a ix: --¿B'ajtil ix k'och winhaj Ahimaas yet' winhaj Jonatán t'a tik? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi ix icha tik: --Hato wal yek'b'at heb' winh tik. Wan am wal sk'och heb' winh t'a sti' ha ha' chi', xchi ix. Ix komon b'at tzak'an heb' winh t'a spatik heb' winh chawanh chi' yalani, palta maj ilchajlaj heb' winh yuj heb' winh, yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik toxo ix meltzajxikan heb' winh chi', ix k'exta heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a yol jun olan chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey David to sk'axpaj winh t'a ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' winh chi', yujto toxo ix ak'ji sk'ol winhaj Absalón yuj winhaj Ahitofel yik skot heb' winh yak' owal yet' heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David chi', ix k'e waan winh yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi', elanhchamel ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán chi'. Haxo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, manhxalaj junok mach ayek' t'a sk'axepal ek'ta ha' chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ahitofel chi' to maj ochlaj yopisio tas ix yal winh, ix yak'anoch stz'um schej winh, ix pax winh t'a spat t'a schonhab' b'aj aljinak. Masanil tastak ay t'a winh, ix sb'okan yumal winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix st'unhb'ank'e sb'a winh, ix cham winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Ahitofel chi', ix mukchaj winh b'aj mukan smam.
Ix k'och winhaj rey David chi' t'a Mahanaim, haxo winhaj Absalón ix b'at winh t'a spatik winh, ix k'axpajpax winh t'a ha' Jordán yet' masanil heb' soldado israel.

Ix yak'och winhaj Amasa winhaj Absalón chi' yajalok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab. Ha winhaj Amasa chi' yuninal winh jun winh ismaelita skuchan Itra, yik'lajnak sb'a winh yet' jun ix skuchan Abigail yune' ix Nahas snulej ix Sarvia, snun winhaj Joab.
Ix sb'ok'e scampamento winhaj Absalón chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj David chi' t'a Mahanaim, ix jawi jaywanh heb' winh winak t'a winh, haton winhaj Sobi yune' ix Nahas aj Rabá t'a yol yik Amón, winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Amiel aj Lo-debar yet' winhaj Barzilai aj Rogelim t'a yol yik Galaad.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi', yet'nak alanh heb' winh yet' palangana, lum chen, ixim trigo, ixim cebada, ixim harina yet' ixim trigo mayb'il, anh awastut, anh lenteja,

yet'nakpax nok' yal chab' heb' winh, nok' queso, nok' crema yet' pax nok' kalnel. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik'b'at heb' winh yab'lej winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' winh. Yujto spetoj winh yet' masanil heb' anima chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, yuj chi' ix sna heb' winh icha tik: Tekan k'unb'inak yaj heb', tzam takjilaj sti' heb', tzam ochpaxlaj swejel heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix spojan snanhal masanil heb' soldado winhaj rey David chi', ix yak'anoch yajalil junjun mil yet' junjun cien soldado winh.

Ox makan ix aj spojanb'at heb' soldado chi' winh. Ha winhaj Joab ix och yajalil t'a jun makan, haxo t'a junxo makan, a winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab chi' ix ochi. Haxo junxo makan jun, a winhaj Itai aj Gat ix och yajalil t'ay. Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a masanil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ol in b'at heyet'ok t'a owal chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Maay mamin rey, max yal-laj a b'ati, yujto a heb' ajk'ol chi' a ach tzach sayek' heb', a onh pax tik ta tzonh kolchaji, ma tzonh cham nanhalok yuj heb', malaj kelk'ochi, palta a ach tik ek'b'al sniwanil elk'och t'a yichanh 10 milok onh a onh tik. Yuj chi' wach' tzach kan t'a yol chonhab' tik. Tato ay b'aj ijan tzonh ak'ji ganar, b'at onh a kolo', xchi heb' winh.
--Ichokab'ta', ol in k'anab'ajej tas tzeyal chi', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix elul linhan winh t'a jun niwan spuertail chonhab' chi' yik syilan winh yelta heb' soldado t'a makkiltakil t'a stzolal.

Ix cham wal yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab, t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a winhaj Itai, haton heb' sat yaj t'a heb' soldado chi', ix yal winh icha tik: Yujto ay welk'och t'a he sat, yuj chi' malajokab' tas tz'utaj winhaj Absalón. Masanil heb' soldado ix ab'an tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a owal yet' heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Absalón chi'. Ix schalaj sb'a heb' t'a skaltak te te' t'a yol yik Efraín.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado winhaj Absalón chi' yuj heb' soldado winh rey chi'. Te niwan heb' ix cham t'a jun k'u chi', 20 mil heb' ix chami.
Ha t'a skaltak te te' chi' ix och owal, te niwan anima ix cham yuj satb'at t'a kaltak te' chi' t'a yichanh heb' ix xikjicham t'a k'een espada.

Ayk'e winhaj Absalón chi' t'a yib'anh jun nok' smula. Ayik ix schalan sb'a winh yet' heb' soldado winhaj rey David chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a spatik. Haxo ix aji, ha t'a yalanh sk'ab' jun te' mach' ix ek' nhiknaj nok'. Ix kan nhak'naj sjolom winh t'a skal xachul te' sk'ab' chi', ix kan lokan winh, haxo nok' chej chi' ix b'atnhej nok'.
k'okb'il wal ay jun winh soldado ix hilani, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Joab icha tik: --Lokankan winhaj Absalón t'a skal sk'ab' jun te' mach' ix wila'', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh: --Tato ix il icha chi', ¿tas yuj maj a wach' milejcham winh? Tato icha chi', yowalil swak' spak t'ayach, swak'an lajunheok ciclo plata t'ayach yet' jun niwan tzek'ul, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Wach'chom tzak' junok mil k'een plata chi' t'ayin, max wak'och in k'ab' t'a winh yuninal winh rey chi', yujto ix kab' wal tas ix yutej winh yalankot t'ayach, t'a winhaj Abisai yet' t'a winhaj Itai to malaj tas tz'utaj winhaj Absalón chi'.
Hanhejtona' tato ix in milcham winh, tzam kotnhej t'a wib'anh yujto malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak t'a winh rey chi', ¿tom tzato in a kolo'? xchi winh soldado chi'.

--Nab'anhej swik'ek' tiempo het'ok, xchi winhaj Joab chi'. Ix yik'anb'at oxe' k'een yunetak lanza winh, ix b'at stekanoch k'een winh t'a spixan winhaj Absalón chi'. Yujto pitzanto winh, yuj chi' ix oymaj lajunhwanh heb' stanhwumal winhaj Joab chi' t'a spatik winh, ix swach' milancham winh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' to spukhaj k'een trompeta yik mantzak b'at heb' soldado t'a spatik heb' yetisraelal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at sniwanil winhaj Absalón chi' heb', ix b'at yak'anoch heb' t'a yol jun olan t'a kaltak te' chi', ix k'ekan jun niwan b'ulanh k'een t'a yib'anh yuj heb'. Haxo pax heb' soldado winhaj Absalón chi' ixto kani, ix el heb' elelal, ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ayik pitzanto winhaj Absalón chi', ay jun monumento yak'nak b'ojok winh t'a jun lugar skuch sch'olanil yik heb' winh rey. Ha sb'i winh ix yak'kanoch t'ay, yujto malaj junok yuninal winh tz'ak'ankan b'inajok: “Smonumento winhaj Absalón” ix sb'iejkani.
Haxo winhaj Ahimaas yuninal winhaj Sadoc, ix halan t'a winhaj Joab: --Swal t'ayach, cha in b'ati yik b'at wal t'a winh rey to a Jehová toxo ix kolanel winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'ool, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Max yal-laj a b'ati, manh a mojok a ach ol b'at al jun lolonel chi', tope hato t'a junelxo ol ach b'atok, palta a tiknaik maay, yujto a wal winh yuninal winh rey chi' ix chami, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab t'a jun winh soldado aj Etiopía: --Ixik, al t'a winh rey tas ix il chi', xchi winh. Ix em nhojan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a yichanh winhaj Joab chi', ix b'at lemnaj winh yal t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Ahimaas t'a winhaj Joab chi': --Elok wal t'a a k'ool, cha in b'at t'a spatik winh aj Etiopía chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wipax winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal yuj tza nib'ej tzach b'ati? ¿Tok ay tas ol ik' t'a jun lolonel chi'? xchi winh.

--Malaj yelk'ochi, wach'chom malaj tas swik' t'ay, palta ol in b'at lemnajok, xchi winh. --Ixik an, xchi winhaj Joab chi'. Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix b'at lemnaj winhaj Ahimaas chi' t'a jun ak'lik, ix b'ab'laj winh yuj winh aj Etiopía chi'.

k'ojanem winhaj rey David t'a snanhal chab' spuertail chonhab' chi', haxo pax winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi', ayek' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh smuroal b'aj ayoch puerta chi'. Ix yilan winh skot jun winh winak sch'okojil, te yelk'olal skot winh.
Te chaanh ix awaj winh, ix yalan winh to ay jun winh sjawi. Ix yalan winh rey chi': --Tato sch'okoj winh, alum wach' ab'ix winh syal chi', xchi winh rey chi'. Ayik lak'anxo sjawi winh,

ix yilan winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi' to tzak'an skot junxo winh, ix awaj winh t'a winh tanhwum puerta chi': --Ay wal junxo winh winak te yelk'olal skoti, xchi winh. --Hanheja' wach' ab'ix tzul yal junxo winh chi', xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi': --Ha jun winh b'ab'el chi' icha wal sb'ey winhaj Ahimaas yuninal winhaj Sadoc swila', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Tato a winh chi', wach' spensar winh, wach' am tas ol ul yal winh, xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix jawi winhaj Ahimaas chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh, ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ol winh rey chi' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yujto a heb' ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ayach, toxo ix satjiel heb' yuj Jehová, xchi winh.

--¿Wach'am sk'ol winhaj Absalón ix ila'? xchi winh rey chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Ahimaas chi' icha tik: --Toxonhej somsoman anima yik ix in chekjikot yuj winh a chekab' aj Joab, majxo wab'i tas ix uji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --B'esek' jab'ok a b'a t'a chi', tzach kan ta', xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajan winh yochkan linhan ta'.

Hato wal chi' ix ja nhiknaj winh aj Etiopía chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, cha jun wach' ab'ix tzul wal tik t'ayach: Ha tiknaik, toxo ix ach skolel Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' masanil heb' ix och ajk'olal t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Xalpax winhaj kelem Absalón ¿wach'am sk'ol winh? xchi winh rey chi'. Ix tak'wi winh aj Etiopía chi': --Mamin rey, tzok wal kot t'a yib'anh masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach icha ix aj skot t'a yib'anh winh chi', xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winh rey chi', ix och pitz'an t'a spixan winh, ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh b'aj ay spuertail jun chonhab' chi'. Wan sb'ey winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ay, ay ach wuninal aj Absalón. Komonok a in ix in cham a k'exulok, xchi winh.

Ix yab'an heb' anima to a winhaj rey David ste ok' winh yuj schamel winhaj Absalón, winh yuninal, yuj chi' a tzalajk'olal yuj b'aj ix yak' ganar owal heb' t'a jun k'u chi', ix meltzajkanoch t'a kusk'olal. Ha heb' soldado ix xit'ek' t'a owal chi', q'uixwelalxonhej ix aj sjax heb', elk'altakxonhej ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ichato toxonhej ix el heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'. Ha winhaj rey David chi', makan sat winh tz'el yaw winh: Ay ach wuninal aj Absalón. Ay ach wuninal aj Absalón, xchi winh. Ix yab' winhaj Joab to wan yok' winh rey chi' yuj winh yuninal chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winh rey chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik wan ak'an q'uixwelal heb' a soldado ix ach kolanel yet' heb' al uninal yet' heb' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' ix schab'il etb'eyum.

Wan a ch'oxaneli to malaj yelk'och heb' etyajalil yet' heb' a soldado t'a yol a sat. Ha heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayach, te xajan heb' uuj, haxo heb' tzach xajanan tik, wan a chakankanel heb'. Ha tiknaik snachajel wuuj, tekan wach' ix ab'i tato maj cham winhaj Absalón chi', a onhxo pax tik jun, onh chamokab' ko masanil.

Yuj chi', a tiknaik elanhkoti, tzak'an sniwanil sk'ol masanil heb' a soldado. Tato manh ol ach elok, wal t'a yichanh Jehová swala', manhxa junok mach ayek' het'ok ol q'uinhib'ok. Tato icha chi', te chuk tas ol ja t'a ib'anh tiknaik t'a yichanh tastak ek'nak t'a ib'anh yiktax kelem achto, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Yuj chi' ix k'e waan winh rey chi', ix elta winh, ix b'at em k'ojan winh t'a sti' spuertail chonhab' chi'. Ayik ix alchaj yab' masanil heb' chonhab', ix ja heb' t'a yichanh winh. Haxo pax heb' israel ayoch yet' winhaj Absalón, elelal ix aj spax heb' t'a spat.

Masanil makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel chi' ix laj yal heb' icha tik: Ha winhaj rey David tik ix onh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' kajk'ool, haxo tiknaik, yuj winhaj Absalón, ix el winh elelal t'a ko makb'en tik.
Ha winhaj Absalón chi' ix ko komon ak'ejoch ko reyalok, toxo ix champax winh t'a owal. ¿Tas sko tanhwejek, yuj chi' max kik'xikot winhaj rey David chi' ko reyalok? xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', a winh rey chi' ix chekanb'at aljok t'a heb' winh sacerdote, haton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar icha tik: Alek t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Judá icha tik: Toxo ix wab'i tastak wan yalan juntzanhxo makanhil heb' ketchonhab'. ¿Tas yuj tzak'anxo tze na' tas tz'aj in k'ochxi t'a in palacio?
Ayto wuj in b'a heyet'ok, junnhej pax kinhtilal, ¿tas yuj tzak'anxo tzul in eyik'xib'at t'a in palacio? xe chi t'a heb', xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh rey chi' to sb'at alchaj t'a winhaj Amasa icha tik: Ha ach tik ayto wuj in b'a het'ok, yuj chi' a tiknaik, a ach ol ach och yajalilok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab. Tato max elk'och tas wan walan tik, aokab' Dios tz'ak'ankot yaelal t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smontanxi heb' aj Judá chi' winh rey chi', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb', ix yalanb'at heb' t'a winh to smeltzajxikot winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' ix kot winh rey chi', ix jawi winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán. Ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' aj Judá t'a Gilgal yik tzul schaanek'ta winh rey chi' heb' t'a yol ha ha' chi'.
Hanhejtona' pax winhaj Simei yuninal winhaj Gera aj Bahurim, t'a yinhtilal Benjamín, elanhchamel ix kot winh yet' heb' aj Judá, yik tzul schaan winh rey chi' heb'.

Tzak'anoch mil heb' soldado yinhtilal Benjamín yuj winhaj Simei chi'. Haxo pax winhaj Siba, chekab' yaj t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Saúl, 15 heb' yuninal winh yet'nak yet' pax 20 heb' schekab' winh, ix b'ab'laj k'och heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán.

Elanhchamel ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a sjayil ha' yik syik'anek'ta heb' yuninal winh rey chi' heb' yet' ix yetb'eyum winh. Ix kolwajpax heb' t'a b'ajtak syal winh rey chi'. Ayik mantzak k'axpajek'ta winh rey t'a yol ha' chi', ix k'och winhaj Simei, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin ak' niwank'olal yik maxtzak a nakot in mul ix och t'ayach a in a chekab' in tik, ayik ix ach el t'a Jerusalén. Mokab' kot owal t'ayin.
Swojtakejeli to chuk ix wutej in b'a, yuj chi' ha t'a yinhtilal José, a in ix in b'ab'laj jawi ul ach in cha mamin rey, xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia ix halan icha tik: --Ha winhaj Simei tik, smoj scham winh yujto ix skatab'ej winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová tik winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal eyoch a ex yune' ex ix Sarvia tik t'a jun lolonel tik? Manhxo eyak' somchaj in k'ool. Ha tiknaik wojtakxo to ol in ochxok sreyalok heb' wetisraelal, yuj chi' malaj junok mach syal scham t'a yol ko chonhab' tik tiknaik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Simei chi' icha tik: --Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol ach in mil-laj, xchi winh.

Ix kotpax winhaj Mefi-boset yixchikin winhaj Saúl, ul scha winh rey chi'. Yiktax ix elkan winh rey chi' elelal, masanto ix meltzaj winh t'a junk'olal, malaj junelok ix sb'ikel yok winh, maj sjoxel-laj jab'ok snhitak xil sti' winh, maj sk'exel spichul winh.
Ayik ix el winhaj Mefi-boset t'a Jerusalén, ix kot winh scha winh rey chi', ayik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj maj ach b'at wet'ok? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Mefi-boset chi': --Mamin rey, yujto chuklaj wok, yuj chi' ix wal t'a winh in chekab' aj Siba to syak'och stz'um nok' in b'uru winh, tzin k'e t'a yib'anh nok' yik tzin b'at het'ok walani, palta ix smusej in sat winh.
Ix yesejpaxel in ti'ok winh t'ayach. Ha ach tik mamin rey, lajan ach icha junok Yángel Dios. Elokab' k'och tas tza nib'ej.
Wach'chom masanil yinhtilal in mam wicham syal a milanchamok, palta ix in awtej wael het'ok t'a a mexa, yuj chi' manhxalaj tas wach' walani, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manhxalaj tas wach' kalani, toxo ix in na to tza pukek' lum a lu'um yet' winhaj Siba, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Mefi-boset chi': --Kanokab' lum lum chi' t'a winhaj Siba chi' smasanil, a jun niwan yelk'ochi to tzalajk'olal tzach jax t'a a palacio junelxo, xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' winhaj Barzilai aj Galaad, ix emta winh t'a Rogelim ix ul yilan winh sk'axpajkanek'ta winh rey chi' t'a yol ha' Jordán, yik spuklankan sb'a winh yet' winh.
Te icham winakxo winhaj Barzilai chi', 80 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh. Ayik ayek' winh rey chi' t'a Mahanaim, ix b'at winh yak'nhej swael winh rey chi', yujto te b'eyum winh.
Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Konh wet'ok t'a Jerusalén, hata' ol ach ajnhej wet'ok, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Barzilai chi' icha tik: --Jayexonhej ab'il pitzan in, nab'anhejxom tzin b'at et' t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ayxo 80 ab'il in k 'inal, maxtzak wab'laj swach'il tas tzin wa yet' tas swuk'ej, maxtzak yal-laj wilani tato wach' mato maay, maxtzak wab'laj sb'itan heb' winh sb'itani yet' heb' ix sb'itani. Nab'axonhej am ipan in swak'och in b'a a k'atk'ej.
Anhejto tzin k'axpajek' t'a yol ha' Jordán tik tzin b'at jab'okxo het'ok, swilan a b'atkani. ¿Tasto wal yuj tzala' to tzin b'at het'ok t'a Jerusalén yuj spakok swach'il in k'ool?

Yuj chi' elok t'a a k'ool, tzin a cha meltzaj t'a in pat, haxonhej to tzin tanhwej in chami, ol in mukjok b'aj mukan in mam in nun. Anhej jun, ay jun a chekab' syal ik'anb'at mamin rey, haton winh wuninal skuchan Quimam, ik'b'at winh, tzak'an a wach'k'olal chi' t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': --B'atokab' winh wet' an. Ichokab' chi' tz'aji. Yalnhej tas tza k'an yuj winh, ol wak' t'a winh, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' ajun yet' winh rey chi', ix k'axpajek'ta heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán, ix k'axpajpaxek' winh rey chi', ix stz'ub'ankanelta sti' winhaj Barzilai chi' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh, ix paxkan winh t'a spat.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' t'a Gilgal, ajun winhaj Quimam chi' yet' winh yet' masanil heb' aj Judá, ajun pax nanhalxo heb' israel.

Masanil heb' soldado israel ix b'at ilan winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj anhej heb' ketchonhab' yinhtilal Judá ix ach ik'ankoti, ix ach ik'anek'ta t'a yol ha' Jordán yet' heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal yet' masanil heb' a soldado? xchi heb'.

Haxo heb' aj Judá chi' ix tak'wi t'a heb' yetisraelal chi': --Yujto a winh rey tik ayto kuj ko b'a yet' winh, yuj chi' max yal-laj skot eyowal t'ayonh, ¿tok ha t'a spatik winh tzonh wa'i? ¿tokwal ay jab'ok ko ganar yet' winh? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' t'ay: --Wach'chom icha chi', palta a onh tik lajunh makan inhtilal onh t'a eyichanh, yuj chi' te ay kalan kik t'a winh t'a eyichanh. ¿Tas yuj tzonh he patikejkani? ¿Tom manhok onh ix ko b'ab'laj alej to smeltzajxi winh ko reyal? xchi heb'. Palta a heb' aj Judá chi', ek'to te ya tas ix yal heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal chi'.

Ay jun winh winak yelxo te chuk spensar t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri. Ix spu nok' sch'aak winh, ix k'e somnaj heb' anima chi' yuj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha onh tik malaj kalan kik t'a winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí tik. Konh paxek t'a ko pat ko masanil a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', masanil heb' israel chi' ix aktankan winhaj rey David chi', haxo yet' winhaj Seba chi' ix b'at heb'. Haxo heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá, ix kannhej heb' yet' winh rey chi', ix kot heb' yet' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán masanto t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ix jax winhaj rey David chi' t'a spalacio t'a Jerusalén, ix yik'anelta lajunhwanh heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh, haton heb' ix aykan stanhwej spat winh chi', ch'ok junxo pat b'aj ix tanhwaj heb' ix. Toxonhej ix ak'ji tas swa heb' ix, palta majxo waylaj winh yet' heb' ix. Hata' ix kannhej heb' ix masanto ix cham heb' ix, icha heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix ajkan heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Amasa: --B'at molb'ejkot masanil heb' winh winak yik Judá, haxo chab'ej tzach jawi yet' heb' winh t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Amasa chi' smolb'ej heb' winh, palta ix ek' tiempo, maj jalaj winh icha wal sk'ual yaj yalankan heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Abisai: --Tekan to ek'b'al ol onh yixtej winhaj Seba tik t'a yichanh icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Absalón. Yuj chi' kuchb'ej masanil heb' soldado, tzach b'at t'a spatik winh, haxo talaj tz'aji tz'och winh skol sb'a t'a junok chonhab' ayoch smuroal, tz'el winh t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' soldado yik winhaj Joab yet' heb' cereteo, heb' peleteo yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado te jelan, ix el heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Abisai chi' t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil jun niwan tenam ay t'a Gabaón, hata' ix schalaj sb'a winhaj Amasa chi' yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Joab ayoch spichul winh yik owal, ayoch jun cincho t'a snanhal winh. Ha t'a snanhal winh chi' jachanoch jun k'een espada ayem t'a yol yatut. Ayik wan sk'och winh yak' stzatzil sk'ol winhaj Amasa chi', ix k'eta jasnaj k'een yespada winh chi', ix sik'anxik'e k'een winh.
Ix syaman xil sti' winhaj Amasa chi' winh yet' swach' k'ab' yik stz'ub'anelta sti' winh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Wach' am ix ach ajelk'och wuk'tak? xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Ha winhaj Amasa chi' max snalaj winh yuj k'een espada ix siq'uixk'e winhaj Joab chi'. Haxo ix aji, ix stipanoch k'een winh t'a sk'ol winhaj Amasa chi'. Ix elta lanhnaj yol sk'ol winh smasanil t'a sat lu'um. Junnhej ix yak' winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh, ix cham winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' winh yuk'tak chi', haton winhaj Abisai t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' soldado winhaj Joab chi' ix och linhan t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha mach ayoch yet' winhaj Joab yet' pax winhaj rey David, ochokab' tzak'an yuj winhaj Joab chi', xchi winh.

Ix kan telan sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi' t'a skal schiq'uil t'a yol b'e chi'. Ayik ix yilan jun winh soldado chi' to ayik wan yek'ta heb' soldado t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', tz'och linhan heb' yila', yuj chi' ix snherkanel winh t'a ti' b'e, ix slich'anb'at jun k'apak winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayik toxo ix snherkanel winh chi', ix ek'b'at heb' soldado smasanil, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Joab say winhaj Seba chi'.

Ha winhaj Seba chi', ix ek' winh smolb'ej heb' soldado t'a junjun makan yinhtilal heb' israel, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Abel-bet-maaca. Haxo masanil heb' yinhtilal Bicri tzak'anxo och heb' yuj winh, ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' soldado winhaj Joab t'a Abel-bet-maaca chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik, ix sb'oanoch lum lum heb' stek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak smuroal chonhab' chi', yik syak'an owal heb' t'ay. Ix och ijan heb' smak'anem weknaj smuroal chi'.

Hata' ay jun ix ix te ay spensar, ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ab'ek, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Alek t'a winhaj Joab chi' to skot winh t'a tik, yujto tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' winh, xchi ix.

Ayik ix k'och winh t'a slak'anil ix, ix sk'anb'an ix icha tik: --¿Tom a ach tik ach Joab? xchi ix t'a winh. --Ha in toni, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Ab' tas ol wal a in a chekab' in tik, xchi ix. --Tik swab'i, xchi winh.
Ix syamanoch ix yalan icha tik: --Ha t'a peka' tz'alji icha tik: Ha mach snib'ej syojtakejel junok tasi, sk'anb'ejokab' t'a chonhab' Abel, xchi. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj junok tasi.

Ha onh kajan onh t'a jun ko chonhab' tik, ichnhej ta' kajeq'ui, k'anab'ajum onh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Dios. Te niwan pax yelk'och jun ko chonhab' tik. Palta a hachxo tik tza nib'ej tza sateli. ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tza satel tastak to yik Jehová yaji? xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Manh ichokta' wan in naani yik tzin sataneli.

Manhok jun chi' sko saya', palta a jun winh skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri aj tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín sko saya'. Ha jun winh chi' ix k'e waan winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj rey David. Anhej winh tzeyak' t'a yol ko k'ab', tzonh el t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi winh. --T'a yib'anh muro tik ol ko julem sjolom winh t'ayach, xchi ix.

Yuj sjelanil spensar ix chi', ix b'at ix smontej heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix stzepanel sjolom winhaj Seba chi' heb', ix sjulanemta heb' t'a winhaj Joab chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to spukhaj nok' ch'aak yik tz'el heb' t'a jun chonhab' chi', yuj chi' ix paxkan junjun heb' soldado t'a spat, ix meltzajpaxkan winhaj Joab chi' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at lolon winh yet' winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj skanxi winhaj Joab chi' yajalil t'a skal masanil heb' soldado yik Israel, haxo pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, a winh yajal yaj t'a heb' cereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo.
Ha winhaj Adoram tz'ilan heb' aynhejkanoch sb'oan munlajel, haxo winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Seva stz'ib'an yab'ixal winh rey chi' t'a stzolal. Haxo winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar, sacerdote yaj heb' winh.
Haxo pax winhaj Ira, aj chonhab' Jair, sacerdote yaj winh t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj rey David, oxe' ab'il ix yak' jun wejel. Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová tas yuj icha chi' tzuji. Ix yalan Jehová chi' icha tik: Wan eyab'an syail yuj jun wejel tik, yuj smul winhaj Saúl yet' yinhtilal, yujto smilnakcham heb' gabaonita winh, xchi.

Yuj chi' ix yawtej heb' gabaonita chi' winh rey chi' yik slolon winh yet' heb'. (Ha heb' gabaonita chi', manh israelok heb', amorreo heb', aykan heb' t'a skal heb' israel chi', yujto ix yak' sti' heb' israel chi' to max satel heb' gabaonita chi' heb'. Palta haxo winhaj Saúl, ix yak'lej winh satanel heb' yuj swach'ilok heb' israel yet' heb' aj Judá yalani.)

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb': --¿Tas wach' tzin k'ulej heyet'ok? ¿Tas spak swak' t'ayex yuj b'aj ix ex ixtaxi, yik wach' syak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a kib'anh a onh schonhab' onh tik? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' gabaonita chi' icha tik: --Ha kowal yet' winhaj Saúl yet' yinhtilal, malaj sb'onab'il, max b'olaj yet' k'een tumin, malaj kalan kik ko milancham junok ex, xchi heb'. Ix yalanxi winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb': --Alek t'ayin an, tas tze nib'ej swak' t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Ko gana tzak'och ukwanhok yinhtilal winhaj Saúl t'a yol ko k'ab', yujto snib'ejnak winh onh sateli yik wach' max onh kan t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik.

Ha heb' ukwanh chi' ol ko milcham heb', ol kak'ank'e lokan heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Gabaa t'a schonhab' winhaj Saúl chi', haton winh sik'nakoch Jehová reyal, xchi heb'. Ix stak'wej winhaj rey David chi' yak'an t'a heb'.

Maj ak'jilaj winhaj Mefi-boset t'a yol sk'ab' heb', haton winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán yixchikin winhaj Saúl, yujto yak'nak sti' winhaj David t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol miljokcham yinhtilal winh.

Ix schekan winh rey chi' yamchaj winhaj Armoni yet' junxo winh skuchan Mefi-boset, haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl yet' ix Rizpa yisil winhaj Aja. Ix schekan winh yamchajpax owanh heb' winh yune' ix yisil winhaj Saúl chi' skuchan Merab, haton heb' winh yune' ix yet' winhaj Adriel, yuninal winhaj Barzilai aj Mehola.

Ix ak'jioch heb' winh ukwanh chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Ix ak'jik'e lokan heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a jolom witz. Icha chi' ix aj scham heb' winh ukwanh chi' t'a stiempoal yel yich sjochchaj ixim cebada.

Haxo ix Rizpa chi' ix lich'anem jun icha nok' lopil t'a sjolom jun k'een k'een, ix kan ix stanhwej sniwanil heb' winh chamnak chi'. Ix kannhej ix ta' yik ix el yich sjochchaj ixim cebada, masanto ix jawi nhab'il k 'inal. Max scha emlaj nok' ostok ix t'a sniwanil heb' winh chi' t'a k'ualil, max schapaxk'ochlaj nok' chium nok' ix t'ak'walil.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David tastak sk'ulej ix Rizpa chi',

ix schekan winh b'at ik'jokkot sb'akil winhaj Saúl yet' yik winh yuninal, haton winhaj Jonatán, t'a chonhab' Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad. Yujto a heb' aj Jabes chi' xit' ik'jinakkot t'a slak'anil mercado yik Bet-sán, b'aj lokankank'e yuj heb' filisteo, ayik smiljicham heb' t'a owal t'a Gilboa.
Ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'jokkot sb'akil heb' winh chi' yet' pax sb'akil heb' winh ukwanh ix k'e lokan chi'.

Ix mukji sb'akil heb' winh chi' t'a Zela t'a yol yik Benjamín, haton b'aj mukan winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix uji masanil tas icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yab' Dios tas ix k'anchaj t'ay yuj swach'ilok chonhab'.
Ix yak'anxi owal heb' filisteo yet' heb' israel, yuj chi' ix b'atxi winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb', palta ix te k'unb'i winh rey chi'.

Ay jun winh skuchan Isbi-benob, yinhtilal heb' chaanh steel, ix snib'ej winh smilcham winh rey chi'. Ha k'een slanza winh, ek'to uke' libra yalil k'een, haxo t'a jun cincho winh ayoch t'a snanhal lokanoch jun k'een espada ak'to.

Haxo winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia ix kolan winhaj rey David chi'. Ix smilancham jun winh filisteo chi' winh, yuj chi' ix yak' sti' heb' soldado t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol ach ko chab'at ket' t'a owal, yik wach' max ach chami, yujto a ach ayachoch yipok ko k'ol a onh israel onh tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anxi owal heb' israel yet' heb' filisteo t'a Gob. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa ix milancham winhaj Saf yinhtilal heb' chaanh steel.

Hanheja' t'a Gob chi' ix ochpax junxo owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ha winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Jaare-oregim aj Belén, ix milancham winhaj Goliat aj Gat. Ha ste'al slanza jun winh chi', lajan spatik icha te te' b'aj tz'och anh ch'al t'a te' jal-lab'.
Ix ochpax junxo owal t'a Gat. Ay jun winh te chaanh steel ta', yinhtilal heb' chaanh steel. Ha jun winh chi', lajchawe' yiximal sk'ab' winh, lajchawe' pax yiximal yok winh.
Ix te b'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado Israel, palta ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj rey David.
Ha heb' winh chanhwanh chi', a winhaj Refa aj Gat ay yinhtilal heb', palta ix ak'ji ganar heb' winh yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' soldado.
Ha winhaj David ix b'itan jun b'it tik t'a Jehová ayik ix kolchajel winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey Saúl yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol t'a winh.
Mamin Jehová, ichato nhak'een aj t'ayin, ichato in cuartel aji, yujto in Kolumal ach.

Ach in Diosal, a t'ayach skot wip, a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, in Tanhwumal aji. In Kolumal ach, te ay a poder. Uuj max in yamchajlaj yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Ha ach ix in a kol t'a mach snib'ej in sataneli.
Smojton wal a b'itaji. Ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach, t'a wal elanhchamel tzin a kolankanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin.
Ha smay chamel ix oymaj t'a in patik. Manh jantakok yaelal ix jawi t'a wib'anh yik tzin sateli.
Ha chamel, ichato toxo ix spixoch slasu t'ayin, ichato ix sb'o in yaalil yik tzin telwi.
Mamin Jehová, ix wal in b'a t'ayach ayik ayinek' t'a skal in somk'olal. Ach in Diosal, ix in k'an a kolwal. Ha t'a a kajnub' ix ab' tas ix wala'. Ix k'och waw t'a a chikin.
Ichato ix ek' jun niwan kixkab' te ow. Ix te ib'xi sb'akhnub'al satcha'anh. Ix tzikub'tanhaj wal yuj yowal a k'ool ach in Diosal.
Ichato ix elta tab' t'a yol a nhi', haxo t'a yol a ti' ichato ix elta jun k'ak' te ow. Ichato ix elta tzipipok tzak'ak' t'a yol a ti' chi'.
Ix a jak satcha'anh, ix ach emuli. Ayoch niwak k'ik'al asun t'a yalanh ok ayik ach emul chi'.
Ay ach k'e t'a yib'anh jun querubín, ix ach b'at jenhenhok, ix ach b'at b'akhachok t'a yib'anh ik'.
k'ub'an ach el b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal. Ix a k'ub'ejel a b'a t'a skal k'ik'al asun b'ut'jinakel yuj ha ha'.
Ach in Diosal, yuj skopopial a tzikikial ix scha sk'ak'al juntzanh tzak'ak' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, ek' achto t'a yib'anh smasanil, ix el aw icha wal sk'anh k'u t'a satcha'anh. Ix kot sakb'at yet' tzak'ak'.
Ix ak'anb'at a jul-lab', haxo heb' ajk'ool ix saklemkanb'at heb' yuj. Ix a julanb'at jun k'ak' tzek' kopnaj t'a skal heb', ix pechchaj heb' yuj.
Mamin Jehová, yuj schaanhil ix ach awaji yuj pax jun ik' te ow ix ak'elta, ix cheklaj yich ha' mar. Yuj pax chi' ix cheklaj yich yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ach in Diosal, masanto t'a satcha'anh ix ak'kot a kolwal t'ayin, ichato ix in ik'k'eta t'a yol jun ha ha' te jul yich.
Ix in a kolan t'a heb' ajk'ool te ay yip, malaj tzin och t'a heb', yelxo wal te tek'an heb' t'a wichanh.
Ix och b'ulnaj heb' t'ayin ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal, a hachxo Jehová ix ach och wet'ok.
Ix in ik'anelta b'aj lot'an, ix in ak'ankanoch b'aj lewan. Ix in a kolo' yujto xajan in uuj.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol ix wutej in b'a. Ix ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yujto malaj in mul,
yujto tzin k'anab'ajej a b'eyb'al. Ach in Diosal, max in k'ulejlaj chukal, malaj in gana swik'kanel in b'a t'ayach.
Naannhej masanil a k'ayb'ub'al wuuj, malaj b'ak'uinh sb'at a lolonel satk'olal wuuj.
Wach'nhej in b'eyb'al t'a ichanh. Ix in ya'ilej in b'a yik max in b'at t'a chukal.
Yujnhejton chi' ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol swutej in b'a, malaj pax in mul t'a ichanh ach Jehová.
Mamin, a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani, ol elk'och syal a lolonel t'a heb'. Ha heb' wach' spensar, wach' pax tzutej a pensar t'a heb'.
Wach' tzutej a b'a t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, palta tza ch'ox a jelanil a tenanek' spensar heb' ixtum anima.
Tza kol heb' emnakil, haxo heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, tzik'emta heb'.
Mamin Jehová, a achton tzak' sakil k'inal t'ayin. Ha achton tzik'kanel k'ik' k'inal t'ayin ach in Diosal.
Yuj a kolwal ix in saklemejb'at heb' soldado, ix in k'axpajek' t'a yib'anh smuroal juntzanh chonhab'.
Ach Jehová in Diosal, yelxo wal te wach' a b'eyb'al. Ha a lolonel ix ak'kani, smoj ton wal malaj ko chab'k'olal t'ay. Tza kolel masanil mach yipk'olal aj yuj.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo Dios, a achnhej. ¿Tokwal ay junokxo kolwajum icha ach tik?
Ach in Diosal, a ach tzak'nhej wip. Ha ach tzin a kuchb'ej t'a jun b'e te wach'.
Icha sb'ey junok nok' k'ultakil chej, icha wal chi' tz'aj in b'ey uuj. T'a sattak witz yeq'ui, tek'tek' waj uuj.
Ha ach tzin a k'ayb'ej t'a owal, tzak'anpax wip yik tzin pakchitan junok jul-lab' nab'a bronce.
Mamin, a ach tzin a tanhwej, tzin a kolani. Ha a wach' k'ab' tzin yamank'e linhan. Yujnhej a wach'k'olal ix in ik'chaanh.
Wach' ix utej in b'e a b'oani yik wach' max in el-laj nhernajok.
Ix in pech heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix yamchaj heb' wuuj. Maj in ochlaj waan masanto ix cham heb' wuuj.
Chok' ix wutejkan heb' yik wach' manhxo ol k'e waan heb'. Ix telwi heb' t'a skal wok.
Ha achton tzak' wip yik swak'an owal. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayin, tzak' yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Ha ach tza pechel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Yuj chi' syal in satanel heb' malaj tzin och t'ay.
Sk'an kolwal heb', palta malaj mach skolan heb'. Stewi heb' t'ayach Jehová, palta max ach tak'wilaj t'a heb'.
Chok' tz'aj heb' wuuj icha wal lum pokok tz'ik'chajk'e waan yuj ik'. Tzin tek'anem heb' icha wal stek'chajem lum sok'om t'a yoltak b'e.
Tzin a kolel t'a yowal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, tzin ak'ankanoch yajalilok juntzanh niwak chonhab'. Ha heb' anima manh wojtakoklaj, a heb' tzin ak'an serwil.
Anhej syab'an wab'ixal heb', tzin sk'anab'ajan heb'. Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', syak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Tz'ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik tz'elta heb' t'a yol scuartel.
Mamin Jehová, pitzan ach. Ach in Kolumal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ach Dios in Kolumal, ik'jokab' chaanh a b'i.
Ha ach tzak' yojtakejel heb' tzin ixtani to ayach och wet'ok. Tzik'ankot heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yalanh in mandar.
Ha ach tzin a kolel t'a yowal sk'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' schichon sk'ool t'ayin. Mamin, tzin a kolanpax t'a heb' komonnhej smak'an anima.
Yuj chi' swal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh niwak chonhab', tzin b'itanpax a b'i.

Uuj wal, swak' ganar niwak owal a in rey in tik, a in sik'b'il in el uuj. T'a masanil tiempo tza ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin, a in David in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal icha ajnak halani, xchi winhaj David t'a sb'it t'a Jehová.

Haton juntzanh slajwub' slolonel winhaj rey David tik: Ha winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí, ix ik'jiwalchaanh winh yuj Dios Haxonhej Ochi. Ix sik'jiel winh yuj Dios chi' yik tz'och winh reyal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob. Te wach' sb'itan winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Ha winh ix halan icha tik:
Ha Yespíritu Jehová tz'ak'an wal juntzanh tik. Ha slolonel ayek' t'a in ti'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ko Kolumal paxi, a ix halan t'ayin: Ha mach tz'ak'an yajalil t'a skal anima t'a stojolal, icha wal snib'ej in k'ool,
lajan wal icha sakil yichchaanh, ayik sk'eul k'u t'a junok k'u te k'achan, malaj asun. Lajan icha sk'achwi ayik toxo ix ek' junok yax nhab' tz'ak'an syaxil sat lum lum, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol aj winhtilal, masanil tas ix yal Dios t'ayin ol elnhejk'ochok, malaj b'ak'uinh ol sk'ex tas ix yalkan chi' t'ayin. Ha Dios chi' ol kolwajnhej wet'ok yik tz'elk'och tastak tzin nib'ej.
Palta masanil heb' sk'ulan chukal, lajan ol aj heb' icha te' q'uiix smolb'aji yik stakji, malaj junok mach syal syamani.

Tato ay junok mach snib'ej smolb'an te', yowalil sk'an junok k'een k'een, ma junok ste'al lanza yik smolb'ani, snhusjitz'a te' t'a yet'tal chi', stz'akanb'at te' junelnhej, xchi winhaj David chi' t'a slajwub'al sb'it tik.

Ha heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David, oxwanh heb' winh: Winh b'ab'el, haton winhaj Joseb-basebet aj Tacmón. Ha t'a junel, 800 winak smilcham winh yet' k'een slanza.

Haxo winh schab'il t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh jelan chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Aho. Ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey David chi' t'a Pas-damim, ix stzuntzejb'at heb' filisteo heb' winh ta' yik syak'an owal heb' winh, haxo yik ix kot heb' filisteo chi' t'a heb' winh, ix el lemnaj heb' yetisraelal heb' winh chi'.

Haxo winhaj Eleazar chi' ix stek'b'ej sb'a, ix smilancham heb' filisteo chi' winh, ix tzatzb'ikanoch b'uk'naj sk'ab' winh t'a yok k'een yespada chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix k'anchaj winh yuj Jehová yik ix yak'an ganar owal chi'. Ayik toxo ix lajwi owal chi', ix meltzajxik'och heb' soldado israel chi' yet' winhaj Eleazar chi' yujnhej yik'anek' heb' masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ajk'ol ix cham chi'.

Haxo winh yoxil, haton winhaj Sama, yuninal winhaj Age aj Arar. Ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo t'a Lehi, haton b'aj awab'il juntzanh tut skuchan lenteja. Hata' ix el lemnaj heb' soldado yik Israel.
Palta ix stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Sama chi' t'a skal juntzanh anh tut chi' yik skolankan winh. Ix smilancham heb' filisteo chi' winh. Ha winh ix k'anchaj yuj Jehová yuj yak'an ganar jun owal chi'.

Ha t'a junel, t'a stiempoal smolji sat awb'en, a heb' winh oxwanh sat yaj t'a skal heb' winh 30 soldado te jelan, ix b'at heb' winh b'aj ayek' winhaj David t'a k'een nhak'een yik Adulam. Haxo pax heb' filisteo, ayek' scampamento heb' t'a spanhanil ch'olan yik Refaim.
Ha t'a Belén, ay jun makan heb' soldado heb' filisteo chi'.
Haxo winhaj David chi' ix halan icha tik: Komonok ay mach tz'ak'an ha ha' skot t'a ha' uk'b'ila' ay t'a spuertail Belén wuk'ej, xchi winh.

Haxo heb' winh oxwanh soldado te jelan chi', ix och heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'an ha ha' chi' heb' winh t'a spuertail Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sekem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um icha junok ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh: Mamin Jehová, ¿tom ol wuk' wal jun ha ha' tik? Tato swuk'ej ha' icha wal to a schiq'uil juntzanh heb' winh tik swuk'ej, yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha'. Ha heb' winh oxwanh soldado te jelan chi', a heb' winh ix k'ulan jun chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia, a winh ayoch yajalilok 30 heb' winh soldado te jelan. Ha junel ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'een slanza. Icha chi' ix aj sniwanb'i yelk'och winh, icha wal heb' winh oxwanh chi'.
Yelxo te niwan ix aj yik'jichaanh winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix ochkan winh yajalilok heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj ochlaj winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Haxo pax winhaj Benaía, yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te jelan winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Chanhwanh heb' soldado aj Moab te jelan ix smilcham winh. Ha junel ayik te ay k'een sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun k'een xab', ix smilancham jun nok' choj winh ta'.

Ay pax jun winh aj Egipto te chaanh steel yet'nak slanza ix smilcham winh. Haxo winh anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a winh aj Egipto chi', ix yik'anek' slanza winh chi' winh, haxo yet' k'een ix smilcham winh aj Egipto chi' winh.
Ha yuj tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Benaía chi', lajan ix aj yelk'och winh icha oxwanh heb' winh soldado te jelan.
Wach'chom niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' winh 30, palta maj ochlaj winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'jioch winh yuj winhaj David yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh 30 jelan chi', ayoch winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Elica haton heb' aj Harod,
winhaj Heles aj Palti, winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa,
winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot, winhaj Mebunai aj Husa,
winhaj Salmón aj Aho, winhaj Maharai aj Netofa,
winhaj Heleb yuninal winhaj Baana, winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín,
winhaj Benaía aj Piratón, winhaj Hidai kajan t'a sti' ha ha' t'a yol yik Gaas,
winhaj Abi-albón aj Arba, winhaj Azmavet aj Bahurim,
winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén, haton winhaj Jonatán yet'
winhaj Sama aj Harod, winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sarar aj Harod paxi,
winhaj Elifelet yuninal winhaj Ahasbai aj Maaca, winhaj Eliam yuninal winhaj Ahitofel aj Gilo,
winhaj Hesrai aj Carmel, winhaj Paarai aj Arba,
winhaj Igal yuninal winhaj Natán aj Soba, winhaj Bani aj Gad,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Beerot, skuchumal syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
yet' winhaj Urías hitita. 37 heb' winh tik t'a smasanil.
Ix kot yowal Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel junelxo, yuj chi' ix yak'och t'a spensar winhaj rey David yik syak' ik'jokchaanh sb'isul heb' soldado yik Israel winh yet' heb' aj Judá.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado ayoch yet'ok: --Ek'anh t'a skal junjun makan heb' ketisraelal, skot t'a Dan masanto t'a chonhab' Beerseba, tzik'ank'e waan sb'isul heb' smojxo yoch soldadoal. Icha chi' ol aj wojtakani jantak heb' t'a smasanil, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi': --Mamin rey, aokab' Jehová ko Diosal tz'ak'an q'uib' sb'isul heb' anima, 100 okab'to tzek' t'a yichanh icha tiknaik, olto ila', palta, ¿tas wal yuj a gana tzik'chaanh sb'isul heb' anima tik? xchi winh.

Palta ix yak'xonhejoch winh rey chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Joab yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado to yowalil tz'ik'jik'e waan sb'isul heb' anima chi'. Yuj chi' ix elta heb' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anab'ajan heb' sb'at b'aj ix alchaj chi'.
Ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán, ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a Aroer t'a snanhal jun panhan. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' t'a Gad yet' t'a Jazer.
Ix b'at heb' t'a Galaad yet' t'a Cades t'a yol smakb'en heb' hitita. Ix b'atpax heb' t'a Dan, ichato chi' ix meltzaj heb' t'a stitak yik Sidón.
Ix b'atpax heb' t'a niwan chonhab' Tiro t'a smakb'en heb' heveo yet' pax schonhab' heb' cananeo. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' t'a chonhab' Beerseba t'a Neguev t'a yol yik Judá.
B'alunhe' uj yet' 20 k'ualxo ix yak' heb' yek' t'a smasanil, ix lajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo winhaj Joab chi' ix ak'an sb'isul heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a winh rey chi': 500 mil heb' winh aj Judá to stiempo yoch t'a soldadoal yet' 800 mil yik juntzanhxo makan heb' israel.

Ixlajwi chi' ix snaan sb'a sk'ool winhaj rey David chi'. Ix och winh t'a ilk'olal yuj b'aj ix yik'k'e waan sb'isul heb' israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, te niwan in mul ix och t'ayach yuj jun tas ix in k'ulej tik. Ha wal tiknaik tzin tewi wal t'ayach to tzik'el jun in mul tik t'a wib'anh. Icha junok anima malaj spensar ix wutej in b'a t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ayik ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ayik mantzak k'e waan winhaj David chi' ix yalan Jehová icha tik t'a winhaj Gad schekab', haton winh ak'um pensar t'a winhaj David chi':
--Ixik al t'a winhaj David to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Oxe' makan yaelal swaltej t'ayach. Ha hachxo ol a sik'lej b'aja junok tza nib'ej, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Gad chi'.

--Hinye, xchi winhaj Gad chi'. Ix ul yalan winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --¿Tzam yal a k'ol sjawi ukeok ab'il wejel t'a yol a chonhab' tik? ¿Mato a gana oxeok ujal tzex ak'ji ganar yuj heb' ajk'ool? ¿Ma a gana oxeok k'ual ilya yik scham anima t'a yol a chonhab' tik? Na' wal sik'lab'il, ol halani. Slajwi chi' ol b'at walanxi t'a Jehová ix in chekankoti, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Maxtzak nachaj wuj tiknaik tas tz'aj walani. Wach' tzonh kan t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yujto niwan tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayonh, mokab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima tzonh kani, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ha t'a jun q'uinhib'alil chi', ix yak'kot jun niwan ilya Jehová t'a skal heb' israel, masanto ix tz'akwi sk'ual ix alchajkan chi'. Yuj chi' 70 mil anima ix cham t'a yol smakb'en heb' chi', ix kotnhej t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba.

Ayik ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' jun ángel t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yik syak' lajwok heb' anima yalani, ix kus sk'ol Jehová yuj tas ix uji chi', yuj chi' ix yal t'a jun ángel chi': k'okb'ilxo chi', ochokab' waan, xchi. Ha t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Arauna aj Jebús, hata' ayek' jun ángel chi' ayik ix alji chi' t'ay.

Ayik ix yilan jun ángel chi' winhaj David, ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: --Ha in ton ay in mul, malaj smul juntzanh anima tik. Tzin k'an t'ayach to ha t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh winhtilal tz'och jun niwan yaelal tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix jawi winhaj Gad yal t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Q'ueanh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Arauna aj Jebús, tza b'oan junok altar t'a Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj David chi' icha ix aj yalan winhaj Gad yuj Jehová.
Ix yilankot winhaj Arauna to wan sk'och winh rey yet' heb' yetyajalil b'aj ayeq'ui, ix kot winh scha winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tzach jawi t'ayin? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Ha yuj in manan jab'ok lugar t'a a tek'lab' trigo tik, ol in b'oank'e junok yaltar Jehová t'ay, yik wach' ol wanaj scham anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Arauna chi': --Ujokab' mamin, b'o'okab'i, tzak'an silab' t'a Jehová icha wal snib'ej a k'ool. Ay nok' wakax syal ak'an silab'il t'a tik. Ay te' mak'lab' trigo yet' te' yugo syal yoch k'atzitzal.
Ha in tik swak' masanil juntzanh tik t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh: --Tzok walel t'a sk'ol Jehová to scha yab' tas ol a k'an t'ay, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Arauna chi' icha tik: --Maay, ol in man masanil juntzanh chi' t'ayach, yujto max yal-laj wak'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal tastak to tonhej tza siej t'ayin, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix sman jun lugar chi' winhaj David chi' yet' nok' wakax t'a 50 siclo k'een plata.

Ix sb'oank'e jun altar winh t'a Jehová, ix yak'an silab' winh snhusji yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal t'ay. Ichato chi' ix schaan yab' Jehová tas ix sk'an winhaj David chi' yuj chamel wan yoch t'a yoltak schonhab' heb' israel. Yuj chi' ix wanaj jun ilya chi'.
